name: Just the photo
description: The picture itself, edge to edge, with your logo and an optional caption. For when the photo says it all: your own, one from the Library, or one AI makes in your brand's style.

caption.label: Caption
caption.description: A short line at the foot of the photo. Leave empty for none.

handle.label: Handle
handle.description: Your account handle, top right, e.g. @yourbrand. Leave empty for none.

photo.label: Photo
photo.description: The photo behind the words: a person, a place or a product, with no words in it. Upload one, pick one from the Library, or let AI make one. Without it, your brand colours show.

sample_data.caption: Fresh from the oven, every morning at 7.
